Specifically capturing the mechanical click paths for importing external HTML/Liquid code into a Shopify theme via the "Edit Code" interface to create custom sections, and adding physical products to populate those custom Liquid templates.
AI image generation prompts and brand board creation -> 04-BRD
Landing page section strategy (e.g., adding "us vs them" or founder blocks) -> 07-LPG

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Provides the exact click path for importing external HTML/Liquid code into a Shopify theme's backend to create custom, reusable page sections without using Shopify's default page builder. modules: [SET] topics: [store configuration] tier: 3 scope_hint: baseline

Look for. The exact click path to inject custom Liquid code into a Shopify theme: Online Store -> Edit Code -> Sections -> Add a new Section -> Name the file (e.g., wle_hair_nectar_gg.liquid) -> Paste HTML/Liquid code -> Save. The exact click path to assign a product to a custom page template: Products -> Add product -> Upload images and set price -> Online Store -> Customize Theme -> Create a new template (e.g., hair_nectar_gg) -> Hide default sections -> Add Section -> Select the custom Liquid file created earlier -> Assign the specific product to populate the section. The exact click path to ensure a product is buyable: Products -> Edit product -> Set Available inventory (e.g., 10,000) -> Save. The process for updating existing custom code: Edit Code -> Paste new code over old code -> Save -> Refresh live page.

Skip. General marketing advice, AI tool promotion (e.g., "White Labeler AI Vault," "Top View," "Claude Design"), branding theory, and dropshipping vs. private labeling strategies. Anything not directly related to the mechanical click paths within the Shopify admin interface.
